cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C5: the defining anionic is the alkyl sulfate Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4 (C3, C4) with two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside@2, Sodium Cocoamphoacetate@5) and no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signals arguing for low: the earliest listed cleansing surfactant is the glucoside@2 ahead of the sulfate, Glycerin@3 also precedes it, and four weak refatters follow; they lower confidence to moderate and name low as the neighbor but do not move the C5 value (C1-C6 conventions). Strong is less realistic (it would need fewer than two buffers or a reinforcing route).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Glucoside-led order (Coco-Glucoside@2 and Glycerin@3 before Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4) and four weak refatters argue for low.
